front.question: 最近消费时间越近分数越高，频次与金额越大分数越高。回忆分五组时让最优组得到5分的写法，以最近日期为例。
front.dataNote: 独立微型教学数据，不是完整企业数据库查询结果。

back.answer: 6 - NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY 最近日期 DESC,客户编号)
back.explanation: 显式编号决胜，三项分数分别排序后合计；同一天不能依赖数据库默认返回顺序。
back.code: SELECT customer_id,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) AS r_score FROM rfm_score ORDER BY customer_id
back.sqliteCode: SELECT customer_id,6-NTILE(5) OVER(ORDER BY last_day DESC,customer_id) AS r_score FROM rfm_score ORDER BY customer_id

front.question: 每采购行分别比较合格收货量和开票量。修正两张明细直接连接造成的数量放大。
front.code: SELECT p.po_item_id,SUM(r.quantity_received-r.quantity_rejected) AS accepted,SUM(b.quantity_billed) AS billed FROM po_mini p LEFT JOIN delivery_mini r ON r.po_item_id=p.po_item_id LEFT JOIN bill_mini b ON b.po_item_id=p.po_item_id GROUP BY p.po_item_id ORDER BY p.po_item_id
front.dataNote: 独立微型教学数据，不是完整企业数据库查询结果。

back.answer: 改用背面的修正语句。
back.explanation: 收货和开票均为一对多，先按采购行独立汇总。数量一致仍需核对金额：示例行1发票价格有差异。
back.code: WITH r AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received-quantity_rejected) AS accepted FROM delivery_mini GROUP BY po_item_id),b AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_billed) AS billed FROM bill_mini GROUP BY po_item_id) SELECT p.po_item_id,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) AS accepted,COALESCE(b.billed,0) AS billed FROM po_mini p LEFT JOIN r ON r.po_item_id=p.po_item_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.po_item_id=p.po_item_id ORDER BY p.po_item_id
back.sqliteCode: WITH r AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_received-quantity_rejected) AS accepted FROM delivery_mini GROUP BY po_item_id),b AS (SELECT po_item_id,SUM(quantity_billed) AS billed FROM bill_mini GROUP BY po_item_id) SELECT p.po_item_id,COALESCE(r.accepted,0) AS accepted,COALESCE(b.billed,0) AS billed FROM po_mini p LEFT JOIN r ON r.po_item_id=p.po_item_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.po_item_id=p.po_item_id ORDER BY p.po_item_id
back.correctionReason: 收货和开票均为一对多，先按采购行独立汇总。数量一致仍需核对金额：示例行1发票价格有差异。
